name: singlet_harmonization_count_matrix_state_detection
title: Count-matrix processing-state detection
description: Labels a stored expression matrix as raw_counts, normalized, log1p, scaled, zscored, pearson_residuals or nonnegative_noninteger, or unknown, from its values, and flags a conflict with the declared or required state. The default method full_scan reads every stored entry once and writes uns/state_report plus per-cell and per-gene summaries. Use it before count-model, size-factor or embedding steps. integrality_only is a fast refusal test for very large inputs and never returns raw_counts. Do not use it to decide normalization, and do not trust a raw_counts label on equal-depth data without the declared state.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

layer.description: Matrix to test, named as layers/<name>; null tests X.

method.description: full_scan checks every stored entry (default). integrality_only applies the integer and sign test only and never returns raw_counts.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

reconciliation.description: Declared-state and required-state options for the conflict flag.

declared_state.description: State recorded by the producer or metadata; a determinate label that differs raises the conflict flag.

required_state.description: State a downstream method needs, using the same labels; null skips the requirement check.

integrity.description: Integer-test options for full_scan and integrality_only.

integer_tolerance.description: Absolute tolerance for integer-valued entries; 0 is exact.

library_size.description: Row-sum and log-inversion options for full_scan.

target_sum_candidates.description: Library-size targets tested for a row-sum match.

log_bases.description: Candidate log bases for inverting shifted logarithms.

rowsum_cv_threshold.description: Row-sum coefficient of variation above which rows count as depth-variable (proposal).

rowsum_rel_tol.description: Relative tolerance for a row sum equal to a candidate target (proposal).

mito.description: Mitochondrial plausibility statistic; never changes the label.

prefixes.description: Gene-name prefixes for mitochondrial genes; species-dependent.

plausibility_max.description: Upper bound on median mitochondrial fraction (proposal).

residual_clip_check.description: Test for a clip bound at sqrt(n_cells) on a gene whose mean is not zero.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs: label, conflict, declared_state, integer_fraction, n_negative, min, max, row_sum_median, row_sum_cv, target_sum_match, log_base_match, mt_fraction_median. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
